arguments.command: cd /workspace && ls -R inputs/ output/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---JSON---"; cat inputs/employee_data.json
cd /workspace && mkdir -p _x && cd _x && unzip -o ../inputs/offer_letter_template.docx >/dev/null && ls -R | head -50

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
for n in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    print('===== '+n+' =====')
    print(z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
for n in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    x=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    # extract visible text per paragraph
    print('=====',n)
    for pm in re.finditer(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>|<w:p/>', x, re.DOTALL):
        txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', pm.group(0), re.DOTALL))
        txt=txt.replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>')
        if txt.strip(): print(repr(txt))
    assert '{{' not in x and '}}' not in x, 'leftover braces'
print('no leftover braces anywhere')
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile, xml.dom.minidom as M
a=set(zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx').namelist())
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
b=set(z.namelist())
print('parts identical set:', a==b)
for n in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml']:
    M.parseString(z.read(n)); print('well-formed:', n)
" && ls -l output/ && md5sum inputs/* 2>/dev/null || sha1sum inputs/*
